Design, characterisation, and clinical evaluation of a novel porous Ti-6Al-4V hemipelvic prosthesis based on Voronoi diagram.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now clinical Exp. validation Patient-specific
Zhuangzhuang Li, Yi Luo, Minxun Lu, Yitian Wang, Linsen Zhong et al. Biomaterials translational 2024-01-01 10.12336/biomatertransl.2024.03.007
单位: Orthopaedic Research Institute and Department of Orthopaedics, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China.; Model Worker and Craftsman Talent Innovation Workshop of Sich
通讯: Chongqi Tu @ Orthopaedic Research Institute and Department of Orthopaedics, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, Chengdu, Sichuan [推断]
相关性: 该论文提出基于Voronoi图设计的多孔钛合金假体，通过压缩测试和临床随访验证了力学性能与骨整合效果，与用户关注的AM生物医学材料方向高度相关。
边界: No fatigue testing and no explicit stress shielding analysis; LPBF fabrication is implied but not explicitly confirmed.
动机· 开发仿生多孔骨盆假体以改善骨整合和力学匹配
方法· 基于Voronoi图算法设计个体化多孔结构，增材制造Ti-6Al-4V假体
结果· 压缩模量1.68 GPa、强度174 MPa，临床随访显示良好骨整合和功能评分
验证· 通过SEM、压缩测试和6例患者临床随访验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To design a biomimetic porous hemipelvic prosthesis achieving favorable osseointegration and mechanical compatibility.
Method· Patient-specific porous structures were generated using Voronoi diagram algorithm and fabricated via additive manufacturing of Ti-6Al-4V.
Result· The porous structure exhibited a Young's modulus of 1.68 GPa and compressive strength of 174 MPa; clinical outcomes showed good osseointegration and a mean MSTS score of 23.2.
Validation· Validation included SEM imaging, compression testing of cubic samples, and clinical follow-up of six patients with X-ray and Tomosynthesis imaging.

Structural and hemodynamic analysis of Weaire-Phelan scaffolds made of Ti-alloy as bone replacement component: A preclinical investigation.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Jaideep Singh Bhardwaj, Souptick Chanda PloS one 2024-01-01 10.1371/journal.pone.0312880
单位: Department of Biosciences and Bioengineering, Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Guwahati, Assam, India.
通讯: Souptick Chanda @ Department of Biosciences and Bioengineering, Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Guwahati, Assam, India. [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接研究了钛合金多孔支架的力学与血流动力学性能，与用户关注的增材制造生物医用材料方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not explicitly quantify stress shielding or report surface roughness and as-built morphology.
动机· 开发新型钛合金多孔支架用于骨替代。
方法· 利用增材制造制备Weaire-Phelan支架，结合有限元、计算流体动力学和压缩实验评估。
结果· 70%-90%孔隙率支架的力学性能匹配天然骨，WPA支架模量更高，WPD支架血流动力学更优。
验证· 通过压缩实验和仿真验证力学和血流动力学性能。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the biomechanical viability of Weaire-Phelan titanium alloy scaffolds as bone replacement components.
Method· Weaire-Phelan scaffolds of varying porosity were additively manufactured and assessed via finite element analysis, computational fluid dynamics, and uniaxial compression tests.
Result· Scaffolds with 70% to 90% porosity exhibited mechanical properties comparable to trabecular bone; WPA scaffolds showed higher compressive modulus while WPD scaffolds demonstrated better hemodynamic performance.
Validation· Mechanical testing (uniaxial compression) and numerical simulations (FEA, CFD) validated the structural and hemodynamic properties.

单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Kanazawa Institute of Technology, Hakusan, Japan.
通讯: Noriyuki Takano @ Integrated Technology Research Center of Medical Science and Engineering, Kanazawa Institute of Technology, Hakusan, Jap [推断]
相关性: 直接研究短柄髋关节假体对齐对初始固定和应力传递的影响，与本方向高度相关。
边界: Does not include experimental validation or patient-specific bone quality variation.
动机· 研究短柄假体对齐对初始固定和应力传递的影响，为手术提供指导。
方法· 基于两例髋关节骨关节炎临床病例，使用非线性有限元方法改变CCD角和屈曲角。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To provide guidelines for short stem installation by numerically investigating the effect of alignment on initial fixation and stress transfer.
Method· Nonlinear finite element models with varied CCD and flexion angles were created based on two clinical hip osteoarthritis cases.
Result· Varus alignment increased medial stem settlement and distal femur stress, while valgus alignment increased proximal stress with slight differences.
Validation· Numerical simulation without experimental validation.

标记：

Small design modifications can improve the primary stability of a fully coated tapered wedge hip stem.

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem pubmed Direct Read now cadaveric Exp. validation
Katja Glismann, Tobias Konow, Frank Lampe, Benjamin Ondruschka, Gerd Huber et al. PloS one 2024-01-01 10.1371/journal.pone.0300956
单位: Institute of Biomechanics, TUHH Hamburg University of Technology, Hamburg, Germany.
通讯: Michael M Morlock @ Institute of Biomechanics, TUHH Hamburg University of Technology, Hamburg, Germany. [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接研究全涂层锥形楔形股骨柄的设计改进对初始稳定性的影响，通过尸体实验测量微动和下沉，与髋关节植入物研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding or bone remodeling, nor does it use computational modeling (FEA) or patient-specific simulations.
动机· 通过设计改进提高全涂层锥形楔形股骨柄在Dorr A型股骨中的初始稳定性。
方法· 使用尸体股骨对（n=6）植入两种柄，记录植入力、接触面积，并在ISO循环加载下用DIC测量微动。
结果· 改进柄植入力高40%，接触面积大23%，下沉量低4倍，初始稳定性显著提高。
验证· 尸体实验结合ISO 7206-4循环加载和数字图像相关测量。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To assess whether small design modifications to a fully coated tapered wedge hip stem improve primary stability in Dorr type A femurs without increasing fracture risk.
Method· Cadaveric paired femurs (n=6 pairs) were implanted with established (Corail) and modified (Emphasys) stems; broaching/implantation forces, contact areas, and relative motions under cyclic ISO 7206-4 loading (up to 1600 N) were measured using digital image correlation.
Result· The modified stem achieved 40% higher implantation forces, 23% larger bone-implant contact area, and four times lower subsidence, indicating improved primary stability.
Validation· In-vitro cadaveric experiment with cyclic mechanical loading per ISO 7206-4 standard, measuring micromotion via DIC.

单位: Intelligent Robotics Institute, School of Mechatronical Engineering, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing 100081, China
通讯: Yanfeng Zhao @ Intelligent Robotics Institute, School of Mechatronical Engineering, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing 100081, C

动机· 构建模拟天然组织的异质微结构方法不足
方法· 集成宏观水凝胶交换、微观细胞操控和封装调控

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Current methods for engineering tissue-mimicking microstructures with multi-extracellular matrix and multicellular features are insufficient.
Method· A versatile method integrating macroscopic hydrogel exchange via electrowetting, microscopic cell manipulation via dielectrophoresis, and encapsulation modulation via dynamic photopolymerization.
Result· Heterogeneous microstructures with controlled cell densities and patterns were constructed, supporting long-term culture of hepatocytes and fibroblasts with high viability.
Validation· In vitro cell culture experiments demonstrated high cell viability (over 90%) and functional effects of cell density on proliferation and urea secretion.

Motivation· To fabricate and characterize a 3D porous metallic scaffold coated with chitosan containing wollastonite nanoparticles for orthopedic applications.
Method· Selective laser melting was used to produce porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds, which were then coated with chitosan containing 0-15 wt% wollastonite nanoparticles.
Result· The scaffold with 10 wt% wollastonite nanoparticles exhibited the highest elastic modulus (~420 MPa) and compressive strength.
Validation· Mechanical compression tests, SEM, XRD, SBF/PBS immersion, and MTT toxicity assays were performed.

动机· 研究孔隙率对SLM制备316L多孔支架性能的影响
方法· 通过有限元分析、SLM制备和微观形貌表征，分析不同结构支架的力学与渗透性能
结果· 支架的弹性模量和抗压强度随孔隙率增大而降低，渗透率在75%孔隙率时最大且压降接近天然骨

Motivation· To investigate the effect of porosity on the mechanical and permeability properties of 316L porous scaffolds fabricated by selective laser melting.
Method· Finite element analysis, SLM fabrication, and micromorphology characterization were employed to evaluate compressive stress, elastic modulus, and permeability for three scaffold structures.
Result· Elastic modulus and compressive stress decreased with increasing porosity; maximum permeability was achieved at 75% porosity, with pressure drop closest to natural bone.
Validation· Experimental fabrication and mechanical testing were compared with finite element simulations.

Motivation· To evaluate the potential of lattice-structured patient-specific implants in reducing stress shielding and facilitating bone ingrowth.
Method· A finite element model was developed and validated against in vivo animal data (n=9) to analyze the mechanical behavior of lattice Ti6Al4V implants in femur bones.

Motivation· To evaluate the biomechanical performance and safety factors of a nickel-free Ti-27Nb hip implant under various real-world physiological loading scenarios using FEA.
Method· A finite element model of the hip implant was constructed and subjected to loads representing seven daily activities at 75 kg and 100 kg body weights.
Result· The implant neck experienced the highest von Mises stresses, especially during stair climbing, and safety factors decreased by up to 58% for heavier body weight, while simulated body fluid treatment had negligible effect.
Validation· The study relied solely on computational simulation without experimental or clinical validation.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To achieve homogeneous osteogenic nanotextures on internal surfaces of macroporous AM implants that are inaccessible by line-of-sight grit blasting.
Method· A calciothermic reaction-based process was applied to direct laser melted TiAl6V4 macroporous constructs after grit blasting and acid etching.
Result· CaR-modified surfaces maintained bone volume and percent bone ingrowth even under a hydrogel challenge that impaired osseointegration in unmodified implants.
Validation· In vivo cranial on-lay model in rats with pull-off force testing and histomorphometric analysis at 4 weeks.

Motivation· To evaluate the effect of nanoscale versus hybrid micro/nanoscale surface topographies on osseointegration at cellular and tissue levels.
Method· In vitro cell culture and in vivo rat implantation compared mesenchymal stem cell and macrophage responses, with single-cell RNA sequencing to identify cell populations.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To review the clinical outcomes of PEEK implants in craniofacial reconstruction and assess surface modification strategies for improving bioactivity.
Method· A systematic review of 32 articles covering 194 patients receiving patient-specific PEEK implants, with analysis of complications and discussion of surface/structural modifications.
Result· Complications including infections and implant failures occurred in 18% of cases; surface modifications such as hydroxyapatite and titanium coatings show promise but have not been clinically reported in facial surgery.
Validation· No experimental validation; the study is a literature review with no in vitro, ex vivo, or clinical testing data.

边界: No finite element modeling, micromotion quantification, or contact mechanics; purely clinical and radiographic outcomes without computational or experimental biomechanics.
动机· 评估非骨水泥短柄假体在10年以上的长期临床和放射学表现。
方法· 前瞻性纳入163例患者，随访10年，分析存活率、Harris评分及放射学应力遮挡。
结果· 10年存活率99.6%，仅9%轻度应力遮挡，但40%出现轻度内翻对线且稳定。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the long-term survival and radiographic outcomes of an uncemented metaphyseal short stem in total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A prospective cohort of 163 patients (172 hips) was followed for a minimum of 10 years with clinical (HHS) and radiographic (stress shielding, osteolysis, alignment) assessments.
Result· The 10-year survival rate was 99.6%, stress shielding was mild in 9% and moderate in 2%, and varus alignment (40%) was not associated with revision or worse outcomes.
Validation· Clinical and radiographic evaluations at minimum 10-year follow-up in a consecutive patient series.

Motivation· Develop a Ti-10Nb alloy with low elastic modulus to mitigate stress shielding in dental implants.
Method· Fabricate the alloy via powder metallurgy using four compaction pressures (600-750 MPa) and vacuum sintering at 1000°C.
Result· The alloy compacted at 750 MPa achieved optimal properties: hardness 450 HV, compressive strength 1543 MPa, elastic modulus 41 GPa, and superior corrosion/wear resistance.
Validation· Mechanical testing (compression, hardness) and electrochemical corrosion tests confirmed the alloy's performance.

Motivation· To compare proximal canal fill ratios between hemiarthroplasty and total hip arthroplasty for femoral neck fracture and arthritis, respectively.
Method· Retrospective case-control study matching 130 HA patients to 328 THA patients, with radiographic CFR measurement at four levels by two independent investigators.
Result· HA demonstrated significantly lower CFR at all levels, especially at the lesser trochanter and in Dorr C femurs, with similar complication rates between groups.
Validation· Interrater agreement for Dorr classification and CFR measurements was assessed with strong correlation.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To assess the readability and quality of online information about osseointegrated limb replacement surgery for amputee patients.
Method· The top 40 websites from three major search engines were evaluated using Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Gunning Fog Index, Flesch Reading Ease, JAMA benchmarks, and HON certificate.
Result· Most websites had poor readability (mean FKGL 11.3, high school level) and low quality (mean JAMA score 1.76/4); none had HON certification.
Validation· Standardized readability and quality metrics were applied to 23 included websites.

Motivation· To evaluate the effect of hydrophilic and rough implant surfaces on peri-implant bone healing in spontaneously hypertensive rats with and without losartan treatment.
Method· Implants with hydrophilic (Acqua) or rough (NeoPoros) surfaces were placed in tibiae of Wistar and SHR rats; some received daily losartan; samples were analyzed after 67 days via immunohistochemistry, biomechanical testing, microCT, and confocal microscopy.

Motivation· To compare crestal bone loss around submerged vs non-submerged dental implants during the osseointegration phase.
Method· Ten subjects with 30 implants were randomized into three groups, and crestal bone loss was evaluated using IOPA radiographs and CBCT at baseline, 1 and 3 months.

Validation· Clinical study with radiographic imaging and repeated measures.

Motivation· To determine whether humeral stem length affects the rate and severity of medial calcar bone resorption in anatomic total shoulder arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective matched cohort study comparing canal-sparing, short, and standard-length humeral implants in 40 patients per group with radiographic evaluation at 3, 6, 12 months.
Result· Canal-sparing designs showed significantly lower early calcar resorption rates and less severe bone loss compared to short and standard-length stems.
Validation· Clinical radiographic follow-up in a 1:1:1 matched patient cohort.

Motivation· To evaluate the role of subscapularis repair in reverse total shoulder arthroplasty and its interaction with medialized vs. lateralized humeral stem designs.

Motivation· To evaluate the indications, complications, survivorship, and functional outcomes of metaphyseal sleeves in revision total knee arthroplasty.
Method· A systematic review following PRISMA guidelines, including prospective and retrospective studies from the past 10 years with minimum 2-year follow-up.
Result· Metaphyseal sleeves demonstrated good functional outcomes, overall survivorship of 92.2%, and aseptic survivorship of 98.2%.
Validation· The review synthesizes evidence from clinical studies without direct experimental validation.

Motivation· To evaluate whether adding a fluoride solution to double acid etched dental implants enhances secondary stability.

Motivation· To evaluate the implant survival and clinical outcomes of an uncemented modular femoral implant in revision total hip arthroplasty with severe femoral bone loss.
Method· A retrospective study was conducted on 100 patients (101 hips) treated with an uncemented modular revision stem, analyzing operative reports, radiographs, and patient-reported outcomes with a minimum 2-year follow-up.
Result· The 5-year implant survival was 95%, all hips showed radiographic osseointegration with no subsidence >5 mm, and 80% demonstrated restoration of proximal femoral bone.
Validation· Clinical validation through Kaplan-Meier survival analysis, Harris Hip Score, and radiographic assessment.
